question: State the balance condition of a Wheatstone bridge and explain why no current flows through the galvanometer at balance.

options.A: The bridge is balanced when $P+Q=R+S$; no current flows because the galvanometer resistance becomes infinite.
options.B: The bridge is balanced when $PQ=RS$; no current flows because the battery current becomes zero.
options.C: The bridge is balanced when $\dfrac{P}{Q}=\dfrac{R}{S}$; at balance, the galvanometer terminals are at the same potential, so no current flows through it.
options.D: The bridge is balanced when $P=Q=R=S$; no current flows because the galvanometer is disconnected.
